heading: Key Sources
title: Therapeutics Initiative - Therapeutics Letter (UBC)
note: independent, bimonthly reviews of drug therapy questions, published since 1994; free

heading: Key Sources
title: WHO - Guide to Good Prescribing: A Practical Manual
note: international; the six-step model of rational prescribing, written for teaching; the record page links the PDF

heading: Key Sources
title: Schiff GD et al. - Principles of Conservative Prescribing
note: international; Arch Intern Med 2011;171(16):1433-40; full text may need a subscription

heading: Where to Check Each Step
title: The steps follow the order of the WHO model, with a check of NP prescribing authority added.

heading: Where to Check Each Step
title:
| Step | Where to check | On NPPR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Define the problem | The BC Guideline or national guideline for the condition | [Approaches](../1%20Approaches/index.md) · [Conditions](../3%20Conditions/index.md) |
| 2. Set the treatment goal | The same guideline's targets and outcomes | The condition page's Key Sources |
| 3. Choose the drug | Therapeutics Initiative, RxFiles, CPS, Health Canada product monographs | [Drug References](Drug%20References.md) |
| 4. Check NP prescribing authority | [BCCNM - Nurse Practitioners: Prescribing Drugs](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/PracticeStandards/Pages/Prescribing.aspx) | [Practice: Prescribing Authority](../6%20Practice/Prescribing%20Authority.md) |
| 5. Check coverage and start | PharmaCare Formulary Search, Special Authority | [Drug Coverage](Drug%20Coverage.md) |
| 6. Inform the patient | Decision aids and patient handouts below | The condition page's Patient Resources |
| 7. Monitor, report and stop | MedEffect adverse reaction reporting, prescribing cascades, deprescribing algorithms | [Drug References](Drug%20References.md#safety-and-supply) · Deprescribing *(coming)* |

heading: Further Resources
title: BC Ministry of Health - Provincial Academic Detailing (PAD) service
note: accredited sessions with a PAD pharmacist on selected drug therapy topics; book through your local academic detailer or PAD@gov.bc.ca

heading: Further Resources
title: Therapeutics Initiative - Prescribing Portraits
note: a snapshot of your own recent prescribing on a topic, compared with other BC clinicians; open to NPs with an active practice; online registration required

heading: Further Resources
title: RxFiles Academic Detailing (Saskatchewan)
note: drug comparison charts and academic detailing; the app needs a subscription

heading: Further Resources
title: Choosing Wisely Canada - Medications
note: campaigns, prescriber tools and quality improvement toolkits on medication use, including antibiotics, opioids, sedatives and PPIs

heading: Further Resources
title: ThinkCascades
note: international, Canadian-led; nine clinically important prescribing cascades in older people; Drugs Aging 2022;39(10):829-40

heading: Further Resources
title: Ottawa Hospital Research Institute - Patient Decision Aids, A to Z inventory
note: decision aids by topic, screened against international standards

heading: NP Prescribing Notes
title: BCCNM - Nurse Practitioners: Prescribing Drugs
